title: A save the grant refused is reported once per cause and grant, and the web's page hide starts no cloud save of it
evidence: Root fix R20 (US-09 AC58): shouldReport in packages/health-core/src/record-host.ts keys each failed-save report by cause and grant, so a repeat is sent with repeat: true (the web host keeps it out of Sentry). The web's page hide (RoadmapStore.flushSync, widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store.ts) calls RecordSession.flushSync('hold'), which starts no save after a refused grant (save-state.ts retryOwed). Left: the iPhone half, ios/engine/cloud.ts cloudVisible() and reread(), which call flushSync() with its default and whose host does not read repeat. Tests: record-session.retry.test.ts, widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store-hide-refused.test.ts
